summary: self-certificates ships hidden dropper that fetches and executes remote Python payload
details: The package advertises in-memory self-signed certificate generation, but its exported generateCertificates() reads test/key.pem, strips the PEM armor, and double-base64-decodes the body into JavaScript that is then executed via the self-sign dependency's default_format path. The decoded JavaScript reconstructs the URL https://aptupdate.org/settings/privacy.php from a further base64 layer, fetches its response, and pipes it into a detached, windowHide-flagged python3/python interpreter over stdin, resulting in arbitrary remote code execution on any consumer that invokes the library. The fake RSA PEM wrapper plus nested base64 encoding of both the payload and the destination URL serve only to conceal the dropper from casual review.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
